svg.title: FafnirDT: long transactions hold every thread. With 2PLSF, short transactions wait and throughput is 0. With FafnirDT, a monitor detects the delay and injects a thread, short transactions flow, and throughput recovers to over 500,000 transactions per second.
svg.text: FAFNIRDT · WHEN LONG TRANSACTIONS HOLD EVERY THREAD
Fixed slots stall. Elastic slots keep going.
no free thread · short txns wait
YCSB write-only · 4.65% overhead under normal load
